claim_scores.rationale: Saves a `Predict` with an LM to JSON, reopens the file, injects `saved_state["lm"]["api_base"]`, and writes the modified JSON back before loading.
Uses `safe_loaded.load(path)` without the opt-in and asserts `api_base` is absent from `safe_loaded.lm.kwargs`, matching default sanitization behavior.
Uses `unsafe_loaded.load(path, allow_unsafe_lm_state=True)` and asserts the injected override URL remains in `unsafe_loaded.lm.kwargs["api_base"]`.
Makes the contrast explicit with both assertions and a print of `safe_kwargs` and `unsafe_kwargs` side by side.
